description: An overview of launch accessories available for the Nintendo Switch 2 from major retailers like Best Buy and GameStop, comparing first-party Nintendo items with cheaper alternatives.
A sponsored review of the Genki Attack Vector grip case featuring a modular design with interchangeable back pieces, full dockability, and a MagSafe-style mount.

A comparison demonstrating that official Nintendo accessories often feature higher build quality and matching aesthetics compared to third-party equivalents, though sometimes at a significantly higher price.
The wireless Nintendo GameCube controller compatible with the Switch 2, bringing nostalgic ergonomics and modern improvements like extra macro buttons.
